name: 03 — Scenario "remove field" (v2-add-field → v3-remove-field, 2-node)
description:
2-node per-context migration for the remove-field scenario. v2-add-field → v3-remove-field drops the `notes: LwwRegister<String>` added in v2. `migrate_v2_to_v3` reads the v2 state (including `notes`) and constructs a v3 state without that field — the bytes for `notes` are deliberately dropped on the floor. Asserts the v2 surviving fields are preserved on BOTH nodes and the v3 binary refuses `set_notes` / `get_notes` (the methods no longer exist).
Note: this scenario is "remove without archive". The archival variant (where the removed field's value is moved into a sibling collection) is a SEPARATE scenario covered by the `scenario-field-remove-archive` fixture pair.
Phase 7d (v3-only setter round-trip) is intentionally skipped: v3 introduces no new exported method — it strictly removes `notes`'s setter/getter. Cross-node convergence is proven via the node-2 schema_info assertion alone.
comment: Migrated from this file's v1 workflow by `merobox cloud port`.
Each of the original scenario's nodes is an account here; see merobox/cloud_v2/port.py for the mapping.
